_comment: Capability contract for the data product lifecycle. For each capability: the stage, keywords used to spot matching skills/agents the user already has, known providers in precedence order, and this plugin's own fallback. Precedence at run time is by LOCATION (project > user > ECC daily links > other plugins > built-ins > ECC library not loaded > plugin fallback); known_providers only help name things and detect dangling names. Set `planned: true` on fallbacks that are not built yet.

intake.plan.description: Restate the task, surface risks and unknowns, produce a step plan before code.

design.impact.description: Blast radius of a schema, model, or interface change: downstream consumers, contracts, rollback.

fallback.name: de-impact
fallback.note: DE extension: dbt manifest refs, exposures, BI lineage

design.data-model.description: Grain, keys, SCD strategy, partitioning, and the tests that encode them.

fallback.name: de-model
fallback.note: dbt model + schema.yml + grain tests + docs from a one-line spec

build.migration.description: Safe, reversible schema and data migrations; expand/contract; batched backfill of columns.

build.tests.description: Tests first for new logic; pytest fixtures, parametrization, coverage.

verify.generic.description: Build, type-check, lint, tests, security grep, diff review; PASS/FAIL report.

verify.reconcile.description: Before/after reconciliation of a changed table or model: row counts, grain uniqueness, measure sums, date bounds.

review.code.description: Find real bugs in a diff or PR before merge; labeled, file:line-anchored findings.

fallback.name: de-code-review
fallback.note: DE-specific: verification ladder, failure modes, risk tiers

review.security.description: Secrets, injection, PII exposure, over-broad IAM in a change.

ship.pr.description: Open the PR with proof of testing, risk tier, and revert steps.

fallback.name: de-pr
fallback.note: wrapper: fills Testing / Risk / How to revert from de-verify output

ship.backfill.description: Bounded, idempotent, partition-aware backfill plan and command.

operate.incident.description: Triage a failed or stale pipeline run from logs to root cause; draft the writeup.

learn.trim.description: Keep the loaded skill set matched to what is actually used.
